schema.ticker: issuer symbol (insiders), asset ticker (House), FINRA symbol (short interest), or the proxy ETF (futures positioning)
schema.public_date: New York date of the rows' public time (acceptance / disclosure / FINRA schedule / CFTC release). JOIN KEY with ticker
schema.tradable_date: first session one could act in (max over the rows of the day)
schema.ins_n_insiders_buy: distinct officers/directors/other (not 10% owners) with an open-market purchase (code P), non-derivative
schema.ins_n_insiders_sell: the same for open-market sales (code S)
schema.ins_net_usd_ex_plan: net excluding lines flagged Rule 10b5-1 True
schema.ins_10b5_1_basis: where the flag came from, '|'-joined: aff10b5One_filing_box / line_element / footnote / unknown
schema.pol_n_members_buy: House members (or spouse/joint) with a purchase disclosed that day
schema.si_settlement_date: FINRA settlement date (NOT the public date)
schema.cot_subject: the WORLD_DIGEST_SUBJECT_PROXIES subject the contract maps to
schema.cot_markets: contracts mapped to this proxy that day ('; '-joined)
schema.cot_pctile_3y: the most extreme headline-group net % OI percentile over 156 weeks, turned into the PROXY's direction (1 = most long the proxy)
schema.cot_chg_z: z of the weekly change (proxy direction)
